olivia: quick design sync — i pushed two variants to figma: `dense-toggle` (single-row compact with metric icons) and `spacious-tiles` (card separators + badges). putting the screenshots here: https://imgur.com/figma-snap. need input on: filter-chip behavior when pinned versions exist, legend visibility, and pin scope wording. ren: i prefer dense-toggle for long compare lists. keeps vertical rhythm. but we need a consistent affordance for the pin so it doesn't disappear in compact mode. maybe a left sticky column with tiny pin icons? paul: agree on sticky pin column. also we currently surface 3 badges (perf/throughput/cost) — they overlap on small widths. proposal: collapse secondary badges into a single "more" chevron that opens a small popover with the rest. keep perf as primary. dina: accessibility note: collapsed badges must be keyboard reachable and announce their contents via SR text. avoid hover-only reveal. Also ensure the chevron has `aria-expanded` and the popover has `role="menu"` + focus trap off (not modal). olivia: microcopy Q: when someone pins a version, should the toast read "Pinned to compare" or "Pinned to your workspace"? we discussed account vs workspace earlier. thoughts? ren: workspace is more accurate for org-shared pins. account-scoped pins feel personal. we should support both but default to workspace for now. tooltip could show scope: "Pinned to workspace". paul: PR backend note: make pin id include scope field so UI can show a small org badge when pinned org-wide. UX: show an owner pill next to the pin icon on hover for clarity. dina: screen-reader text recommendation for the pin toggle: use explicit state: `aria-label="Pin model vX.Y to compare (pinned to workspace)"` when pinned and `aria-label="Pin model vX.Y to compare"` when not. also use `aria-live="polite"` region for confirmations. olivia: good. ren — on legend placement: should we keep legend sticky at top of table or hide it behind an "i"? my thought: sticky compact legend that expands into a keyboard-accessible panel. ren: sticky is good. when collapsed show a short label like "Legend: latency/perf" with a keyboard focus target. expand opens a panel with thresholds (e.g., latency: <120ms = good). include textual thresholds for SR. paul: design nit: focus outline in high-contrast mode currently looks like thick halo and clips badges. suggest 2px solid + 4px inner padding to avoid overlap. confirm with a11y tests. dina: add to checklist: 1) roving tabindex for rows, 2) pin toggle `aria-pressed`, 3) legend panel `role="dialog"` and keyboard-close via Esc, 4) collapsed-badges popover accessible, 5) color + icon not color-only. i'll run a quick audit after the figma update. olivia: implementation detail for collapsed badges: snippet i proposed in the figma notes — attach as reference: ```
``` please review for semantics. ren: looks fine. ensure `aria-expanded` toggles and focus moves into menu. `role=menu` is ok but `listbox` might map better if items are non-actionable; here they're actions so menu is fine. paul: last thought on filters: when users pin versions, filter chips should auto-add a lightweight chip like "Pinned: 3" so it's clear the compare set changed. that chip should be removable to unpin all. dina: chips must be focusable and removable by keyboard (Backspace/Delete) and include `aria-label` like "Remove pinned versions filter (3)". olivia: perfect. i'll update figma with sticky pin column, collapsed-badges pattern, sticky legend panel, and the pinned-chip behavior. opening a PR with screenshots and an accessibility checklist. please review and i'll tag for final a11y sign-off. react with :thumbsup: for sticky pin col + collapsed badges, :eyes: to request changes. thank you! accessibility-bot: Reminder: run color-blind simulator and keyboard-only session + NVDA/VoiceOver passes before merge.
